cases.text: HELM’s abstract frames evaluation around transparency, reports multiple metrics across scenarios, and acknowledges incomplete coverage. Model Cards proposes documentation combining evaluation conditions, intended-use context, and evaluation procedures. Its example smile-detector card excludes emotion inference because the labels concern appearance rather than underlying emotion. BenchRisk explicitly aims to help users identify when to avoid relying on a benchmark. These are substantial precedents for contextual documentation and qualified reliance.
